instruction: Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed.cir` in native PSpice. Save the native simulator output as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed.out`. Read the 1 ms measurements for `Q_AT_1MS` and `QBAR_AT_1MS` from the `.out`, infer each logic state using a 2.5 V threshold (`>= 2.5 V` => `HI`, otherwise `LO`), and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed.json` with keys `t`, `Q`, `QBAR`, `V_Q`, and `V_QBAR`. Express `t` in seconds; for this measurement it is `1e-3` s. [Software] Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. On this machine, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.
